simple.meaning: נְזַק (nᵉzaq) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to suffer (causatively, inflict ) loss.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 4 times across Ezra, Daniel, beginning at Ezra 4:13. Its contexts include family, kingship, city.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נְזַק (H5142).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: נְזַק (nᵉzaq) / H5142 is traced through Ezra 4:13, Ezra 4:15, Ezra 4:22, Daniel 6:3 as a generated source-based concept entry.
